connector.name: Mnemo
connector.registryDescription: Self-correcting agent memory + MCP server: recall, supersede/revert/review corrections, erasure.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package agora-mnemo. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the dancenitra account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: MNEMO_PATH
env.description: Path to the JSON memory file the server persists to (defaults to ./mnemo_memory.json).

env.name: MNEMO_ECHO_GUARD
env.description: 1 (default) blocks a restated retired value from resurrecting a corrected fact; 0 = legacy keyed supersession.

env.name: MNEMO_EMBED_URL
env.description: Optional OpenAI-compatible /embeddings endpoint for SEMANTIC recall (e.g. http://localhost:11434/v1/embeddings for local Ollama). Unset = deterministic lexical recall.

env.name: MNEMO_EMBED_MODEL
env.description: Embedding model id used with MNEMO_EMBED_URL (default: text-embedding-3-small; for Ollama use e.g. nomic-embed-text).
